messages:
jess: FYI hitting a weird json-mode fncall issue in sample-app: when parseguard bot runs during an auth retry the tool output arrives as an escaped string.

omar: Can you dump the server body and the SDK-parsed value?

jess: Server body: {"tool_response":"{\"id\":\"u1\",\"role\":\"admin\"}"} SDK sees a string.

bot-parseguard: parseguard ran post-process for request 1769156789 (run pg-88). It was notified twice due to retry ack race.

tay: Root cause: the bot's post-process mutates payload after initial serialization; on retries it runs again and we end up double-escaping. Node SDK parses JSON before middleware so parity mismatch with Python.

omar: Short mitigation: SDK can try a forgiving one-level parse when tool_response is a string. Patch suggestion: if (typeof resp.tool_response === 'string') try JSON.parse once.

rui: Longer term: add X-Parseguard-Phase header and dedupe bot runs by X-Request-Id. Filed RN-2104. I'll add a small middleware in parseguard to skip re-run when request-id already seen.

jess: Verified staging after middleware dedupe: SDK now receives object in json-mode even with simulated 401->retry. I'll update sample-app onboarding notes with troubleshooting steps.

omar: Good. Follow-ups: 1) Node SDK parity PR (parse after middleware) 2) parseguard header+dedupe 3) add unit tests for retry path.

jess: Thanks all :thumbsup:
